overview_description.description: elGrocer is a UAE-based online grocery delivery and retail technology platform that allows users to order groceries, household essentials, fresh produce, pharmacy items, and specialty products from nearby supermarkets and stores through a mobile app and website. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Dubai, the company operates across all seven Emirates of the UAE.
